title: Permit isolated startup despite foreign active Work Item
outOfScope: Mutating, detaching, renaming, deleting, or manually repairing any foreign linked worktree or its active evidence.
Relaxing malformed, ambiguous, non-dedicated, or requested-task-conflict startup checks.

sources.reason: Authoritative report and acceptance for the asserted foreign-active startup regression.
Latest-main predecessor that already added linked-worktree duplicate handling.
Authoritative startup policy and linked-worktree identity implementation.

riskAssessment.reason: A false allowance can hide unsafe active ownership, while a false rejection blocks independent governed Work Items.

reasons: P1 lifecycle regression and linked-worktree ownership policy require strict evidence.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized autonomous corrective Work Items. A normal ai-start run on latest main succeeded, so this Work Item records and regression-tests that behavior without any bootstrap bypass.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A real linked-worktree normal ai-start invocation creates the unrelated Contract and Summary while one foreign valid active Work Item remains on its dedicated branch.
The foreign Contract and Summary bytes remain unchanged during that invocation.
Starting the same task, malformed or ambiguous active records, and non-dedicated branches remain fail closed.
The final git diff leaves scripts/ai_start.py unchanged and adds an end-to-end regression whose assertions bind normal startup creation and foreign-byte preservation.
guidelines: Use a real Git linked-worktree regression rather than mocked identity classification alone.
Do not mutate foreign linked worktrees or their evidence.
Preserve fail-closed behavior for malformed, ambiguous, non-dedicated, and requested-task-conflict states.
Do not manufacture a source change when current-main behavior already satisfies the reported requirement.

intent.problem: #656 reported that a valid foreign active Work Item on its canonical dedicated branch globally blocked an unrelated normal ai-start after #655 merged. Direct execution on the exact reported latest main instead created this Work Item normally; that outcome must be preserved and protected by end-to-end evidence.
constraints: No bootstrap, manual bypass, or foreign-worktree mutation is authorized now that normal ai-start succeeds.
Do not change the scope of #634, #614, #617, #648, or #654.
intent.rationale: A real normal-start regression test is the smallest truthful correction: it prevents reintroduction and avoids inventing a fix for behavior that current main already provides.

declaredIntent.summary: Prove and preserve isolated normal Work Item startup in the presence of a valid foreign active Work Item.

rawUserRequest: 目标：执行计划，到全部完成。 我授权给你自动执行，写入到每个工单的Contract里。遇到流程问题，要先开工单修正。不要采用临时修补方案。

scenarioCoverage.scenario: One foreign valid active Contract/Summary pair belongs to codex/other-task while ai-start receives new-task.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Normal ai-start creates new-task Contract/Summary and leaves foreign bytes unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Real Git linked-worktree end-to-end test invoking ai_start.main.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The requested task is already owned or foreign active records are malformed, ambiguous, or non-dedicated.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Startup fails closed without creating a second active identity.
